Requirement:
Definition: When the airport adds a new Staff member, the admin records their basic information so the person can be identified and contacted, and their Role and reporting line are clear.
    Precondition: The staff ID is unique and not already assigned to an existing employee.
    Postcondition: A new Staff is created with Id, Name, Password, Phone, and Role. If a Boss is provided and exists, the Staff is linked to that Boss, so the organizational relationship is established.
raw_output:
context AirportSystem::createStaff(id: Integer, name: String, pswd: String, phone: String, role: Integer, bossid: Integer): Boolean
pre:
  Staff.allInstances()->forAll(s | s.Id <> id)
post:
  result = true and
  Staff.allInstances()->exists(s |
    s.oclIsNew() and
    s.Id = id and
    s.Name = name and
    s.Password = pswd and
    s.Phone = phone and
    s.Role = role and
    (Staff.allInstances()@pre->exists(b | b.Id = bossid) implies s.Boss = Staff.allInstances()@pre->any(b | b.Id = bossid)) and
    (not Staff.allInstances()@pre->exists(b | b.Id = bossid) implies s.Boss.oclIsUndefined())
  ) and
  Staff.allInstances()->size() = Staff.allInstances()@pre->size() + 1

raw_output:
context LibraryManagementSystemSystem::borrowBook(uid: String, barcode: String) : Boolean
pre:
    User.allInstances()->exists(u | u.UserID = uid) and
    BookCopy.allInstances()->exists(c | c.Barcode = barcode) and
    let u : User = User.allInstances()->any(x | x.UserID = uid),
        c : BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(x | x.Barcode = barcode)
    in
        u.BorrowStatus <> BorrowStatus::SUSPEND and
        u.LoanedNumber < 5 and
        (
            c.Status = CopyStatus::AVAILABLE or
            (c.Status = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF and c.IsReserved = true and
             c.ReservationRecord->exists(r | r.ReservedUser.UserID = uid))
        )

post:
    let u : User = User.allInstances()->any(x | x.UserID = uid),
        c : BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(x | x.Barcode = barcode),
        newLoan : Loan = (Loan.allInstances() - Loan.allInstances()@pre)->any(true)
    in
        result = true and
        Loan.allInstances()->size() = Loan.allInstances()@pre->size() + 1 and
        newLoan.LoanedUser = u and
        newLoan.LoanedCopy = c and
        newLoan.IsReturned = false and
        newLoan.RenewedTimes = 0 and
        newLoan.ReturnDate.oclIsUndefined() and
        newLoan.LoanDate = Date::now() and
        newLoan.DueDate > newLoan.LoanDate and
        c.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and
        u.LoanedBook->includes(newLoan) and
        c.LoanedRecord->includes(newLoan) and
        u.LoanedNumber = u.LoanedNumber@pre + 1
